notes.title: HOPE V30 is out! Meditation Mode revamp, with LOTS of achievements!
notes.content:
oh boy do we have an update for you guys!

Now that we are done with bugs, we had the chance to focus on features rather than bug fixes, in this major patch, once again you'll notice a huge improvement in the FPS, and many new features which are:
 

[list]
[*]New Saving System! more stable, more adequate to the new design. (it is recommended that you start from a new save file in this patch to progress correctly.
[*] added 64 dragon eggs, spread across all the environments for you guys to collect and explore. each egg gives you a new baby dragon and an inspirational quote in relation to a mental health subject.
[*]NEW fog concept, where the fog lifts off the environment that you go to after you are done meditating
[*]NEW control over the flying sky ocean creatures, you can now turn them on and off as you wish
[*]NEW improved meditation platforms and cycles with nicer VFXs
[*]improved day/night cycle on all the environments, most of the environments now have their own specific day/night cycles, for example, the Arctic's have the auroras, the forest has the starry night and moon, etc...
[*]improved accuracy on the BOX to THE BEAT game
[*]NEW baby dragon varieties added with a variety of drop chances
[/list]

AND so many more fine details that were added but i forgot to archive them, so now i forgot what they were, but you get the idea.

Thank you so much for your continues support, hope you enjoy the new patch and do please let us know if you faced any bugs issues or have an suggestions.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE INCOMING! new engine and HUGE performance boost and BUG FIXES
notes.content:
While I decided to make the project to improve my mental health, I ended up almost losing my mind while making it!
 
Then! We think the black bug is finally fixed
 We believe we have resolved the black screen bug after TONS of research and sleepless nights.
We'd love to hear if you are able to play the game without getting a black screen bug.

Among the many features and updates are:
[list]
[*]BLACK BUG IS GONE!! I hope.... let me know if it happens again please
[*] HUGE FPS increase, as we rewrote the code from scratch, upgraded the engine and optimized everything
[*]New flying creatures in all eight environments
[*]FLYING MANATEES! Perfect for target practice
[*]many other features I probably forgot about while trying to fix the bug, so enjoy!
[/list]

In essence, all of this is working toward the story mode, which would tie all the environments together, bring the archery, meditation, and elemental arrows into one cohesive whole.

Thank you for your patience and support

notes.title: HOPE V19 is OUT! Featuring a new movement system and many new features
notes.content:
Hopefully this version fixes the black screen bug, but if you do encounter it please let us know. It helps a lot!
Please let us know if you encounter it after updating to V19.

Other features include:
[list]
[*] Bug fix for black screen
[*] Time of day is now automatically adjusted for every environment
[*]The meditation mode unlocks all locations, allowing you to meditate in the location of your choice without needing to unlock anything. Just go in and relax.
[*]I started working on the STORY MODE, which will be coming soon, where you will use a bow as your primary weapon in an effort to free the dragons from the bad thoughts that have captured them.
[*] The system of saving has been adjusted
[*]I removed the building blocks mechanic from the game and archived it for future use, since it does not fit with the vision of the game and needs a lot more polishing before you guys can use it.
[*]BRAND NEW MOVEMENT SYSTEM! Instead of teleporting, you can walk with the joystick stuck, rotate in place, or shoot an arrow at teleportation orbs to travel long distances.

[/list]


[b]In the coming weeks, we will mainly work on the story mode of Hope, to get it to a point where you can try it out.[/b]

As always, I would like to thank you for your patience, feedback, and support. You are truly helping to make this game better for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/86ed137af85eb13a077a91ea4cb59196677a1383.png[/img]

notes.title: Black screen on load bug resolved Patch #3
notes.content:
Black screen on load bug resolved Patch #3
We have dug deep into the issue and hopefully resolved it for the last time. Please, if you guys ever face the black screen issue again let us know of the version you were playing and when the black screen happens and we'll make sure to fix any bugs that your report.

though still we would appreciate it if you report any problem you face.

notes.title: THE DRAGONS ARE HERE! OUR BIGGEST UPDATE YET!
notes.content:
so for this patch we decide to go big! it took countless hours of work to get to this point and we are beyond happy with the results, [b]so here are the major updates:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/c5cc11f0c38b4b5dd61e918141b5ad6c787bed66.png[/img]


[list]
[*] NEW DRAGON PET SYSTEM
the old system lacked depth and was too..... meh.... so this new system allows you to hatch dragon eggs, get a random dragon from one of the 3 races: Mouse Dragon, Tiger Dragon and Sea Dragon!
with 4 rarities: Common, Rare, EPIC, LEGENDARY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/deb1ac73ba07d96da5bf1ddb0fc1276d85e47e51.png[/img]

[*]NEW cube Building system and material harvesting system, so you are able to harvest the rocks you find, get cubes, and build what ever you want! as long as it's a cube based structure..... for now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/23699704a006b71af8157358dcd7037f83d26000.png[/img]

 [*]NEW TRAVEL SYSTEM
this one was a pain to develop and you won't notice it, but the entire system that has you moving between environments has been remade to be faster, cleaner and more expandable, allowing us to add more environments easily in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/80e2818d007d36a1a55b2088054934c17b7b06c2.png[/img]

 [*]NEW 3 Slot save system 
the new save system allows for 3 slots, AND allows you to save what you move in the world as well! so it's not just a counter saver type of thingy.
now when you build something,  hatch a new dragon, or interact with any object in any environment, IT IS SAVED! 
god that was painful to set up....



 [*]MUCH better frames and quality settings for you to choose from
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/19244f5d5c683b52c71a831929cee722fcb7d42d.png[/img]


 [*]NEW Breathing exercises and Zen platform optimization
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/698ee594db3ba30286635f4791d6d76c2ed5ea03.png[/img]

 [*]NEW Boxing Level, now we are at 5 boxing levels and will be adding more real soon!
ALSO the boxing levels are much more interesting now with a visualizer music responsive environment!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/35838c0de55388a2820c764db35a4155094f8140.png[/img]


 [*]NEW DAILY LOG IN SYSTEM!
now each daily log in will increase the amount of flying dragons around you, and that applies to all the areas! not just the home area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/5d5e528f9c40fb530d3d604a5821e3b53002fa17.png[/img]

[/list]


[b]and much more! so please log in, try it out, and give us your feed back on what you like the most so we can invest more time in developing the features that you love[/b]

notes.title: THE BIG PATCH IS HERE! a complete upgrade to all the elements of the HOPE VR
notes.content:
in summery, HOPE was having some issues from the last patch, we fixed them all, [b]and added some more goodies for you guys! [/b]



it took quite a bit of work, many many hours of work, but now HOPE VR is up and running! better than ever, and here are the changes that this patch offers:



[list]

[*] [b]NEW Zen Platform[/b] System for meditation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/57493c680d060758994ab349edd461576ec93fe8.png[/img]


[*] [b]NEW Zen Platform Breathing Techniques[/b]/Styles (Earth, water, fire, space), each with different timings, effects and locations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/6c57f49317d5e6c3d07ca18dfa0b5b4e71e6e3a1.png[/img]


[*][b]NEW TRAILER[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/092aac3d077c731f09e0f8e1e00c429840a3b234.png[/img]


[*][b]HOPE has a new look[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/80e2818d007d36a1a55b2088054934c17b7b06c2.png[/img]


[*][b]MORE NEW LOCATIONS!![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/83fdf2dccffb1f1343f93540bb58070b5e48683a.png[/img]

[*]we removed the gun and archery game, and focused all of our attention on the rhythm boxing game, and have tweaked it heavily, both in programming and visuals

[*][b]NEW Rhythm Boxing game[/b], MUCH better than how it was, more responsive, and visually appealing levels that react to the song
[i]Note: we pushed 4 levels into this patch and are currently working on more levels, if you have any feedback on the boxing game let us know so we can tweak and adjust accordingly[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/a4ce4324d4488a4928334a1ffafb408becd556c3.png[/img]

[*] [b]NEW Chaos Platform menu[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/0cbbcb58a0386ee21c75614a2c66db9e69add4ff.png[/img]

[*][b]NEW DAILY REWARDS![/b] unlocking new abilities and locations is now possible through this system, which we can keep building on as develop the game further
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/5d5e528f9c40fb530d3d604a5821e3b53002fa17.png[/img]


[*] [b]New graphics improvements [/b]and better control over the graphics by you guys, in the game without the need to exit to the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/d1251f62d371c158491b730aa203fdf152549625.png[/img]

[*] [b]NEW home environment[/b], where we plan to add more features to connect the worlds you travel to into your home environment 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/f0963b27e3421dea2cfc730153adf844305a730e.png[/img]

[*] [b]NEW home environment real time system[/b], when you log in at night, it's night time, day , it's day , etc... and the effect isn't simply a different lighting system, but a complete change of the sky, effects and sounds.

[*][b]NEW control system[/b], we took inspiration from half life Alyx and re done the entire movement mechanic to be much more comfortable 

[*]Fully tested and integrated the [b]Valve Index VR headset into the game[/b], so now we can officially say steam index supported comfortable


[*][u]we got rid of the black screen bug once and for all[/u], tested the fix on many computers and situations, so please do report any issues you face and we'll get on fixing them straight away!

[/list]





and as always, your feed back is always welcome, whether it's a review, comment or in the community center of HOPE VR, we made this for you after all, so let us know what you think and what you wish to see in it.

notes.title: HOPE V10.0 : (Progressive Meditation) is out! and it's filled with VR Goodness!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958748/b026f6d527897f5165ccb0d6fcbc4c2cfb94fe9c.png[/img]

ok so this one is a game changer, literally! 

We did some research into meditation and it just clicked with us. meditation is not just about sitting down and doing nothing, meditation is achieved through physical activities as well! 

So we branched out and created 3 mini games that focus on hand eye coordination, games that allow you to direct your focus and attention into them without thinking too deeply, to hopefully achieve that ZEN ZONE mode that's hiding within you.

so the new updates include:

[list]
[*] 5 levels/difficulties of our new boxing game

[*]New Dragon Pet
